articles.title: Lanterns: James Gunn Debunks Absurd DCU Ryan Reynolds Rumor
articles.summary: James Gunn, DC Studios co-CEO, recently debunked an early Green Lantern rumor within the DCU. Gunn is also overseeing the development of a 'Lanterns' TV series, which is set to premiere later this year. This announcement provides insight into the upcoming slate of projects for the DC Universe, managing fan expectations regarding character introductions.

articles.title: Subway has a ‘hot’ new menu item that customers are afraid to eat: ‘Why is it gray?’
articles.summary: Subway Canada has launched a new menu item, the 'SubDog,' a nearly half-pound hot dog sandwich. The introduction has garnered significant public attention due to its distinctive gray appearance, which many customers have compared to a submarine. This marketing strategy aims to generate buzz, with the unusual visual aspect becoming a central point of consumer discussion.

articles.title: Show HN: Distributed LLM tracing and GH PR/issue linking [Apache 2.0]
articles.summary: Synty is a tool designed for coders that passively records all coding-agent sessions (like Claude Code, Codex) and GitHub activity. It compiles this data into a local, searchable memo. This system ensures that even though coding agents and users start each session from zero, their past work and insights are preserved and easily accessible, streamlining the development process.

articles.title: The Most Important Record in Music City: Vanderbilt Transplant Center is #1 in the Nation
articles.summary: A commemorative poster by Nashville's historic Hatch Show Print honors the Vanderbilt Transplant Center for its record-setting year, potentially in 2025. This achievement highlights significant milestones in organ transplantation, reflecting advancements in medical science and healthcare. The recognition underscores the center's vital contributions to patient care and medical progress, setting a benchmark in transplant services.
